Just some backseat driving:

I think you should only ask for vehicle controls, lose the bit about having a separate driver, dropping things like a car into world and walking away sounds PC only. Also one of the suggestions that have for feature requests is to only have one per post.

Also you want to sell them on the idea, make whoever reads this want to be a car. Be positive, don't put down your own idea, or at the very least bury it in the middle. You've bookended your post with saying it won't be popular

@{62df7cd83e007e467295c4e1|full_name}: thanks for the feedback. 

One notable features my vehicle avatars have is the ability to get in and out of them. That is true this doesn't really work on quest, but being able to animate this property could still have its uses on quest avatars. For example, a transformer avatar. In vehicle mode, it moves like a vehicle, in robot mode it moves like a humanoid. The separate driver part is still up to the creator to animate correctly, usually via world constraints. I'm not asking for a whole system built in for this. I only want the option to toggle this proposed locomotion changer on and off via animation so you can create things like this and beyond. 

I will try to rephrase this suggestion later on to make the idea sound more appealing. I already have a fairly large fanbase behind my vehicles so I figured I'd just ask them to upvote it but I see what you mean.

details:
Vehicle avatars aren't super popular, I get it. But I would like to see an option to change locomotion controls to be more suitable for vehicles. I love making vehicle avatars, but have always been frustrated at some of the limitations with these. This would be an option on the avatar descriptor component toggled upon upload. Maybe even provide an option to animate this property on and off, so a vehicle avatar containing a driver could see the driver able to lock the vehicle in world space, get out, and return to humanoid controls. 

Vehicle locomotion mode should work as follows:

Moving the mouse should rotate only the "head", keeping the rest of the avatar moving in the direction it was originally facing. This means a vehicle avatar could look around without changing their direction. This could be useful for having a driver in a car avatar able to look around while driving, or a tank to rotate its turret while driving. 

W and S would still represent forward and back, but A and D would be the new rotation keys. Vehicle avatars will not be able to strafe (which is realistic). A and D should rotate the avatar on its Y axis when pressed, possibly with a maximum rotation rate and minimum turning radius that can be specified.

I know this probably won't be a popular idea, but thank you for at least considering this idea.
title: Vehicle locomotion mode for avatars
